```sql
SELECT SUM(r.points) AS season_driver_total_points
FROM main."results" r
JOIN main."races" ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
JOIN main."drivers" d ON r."driverId" = d."driverId"
WHERE d."driverRef" = 'button'
  AND ra."year" = 2009
  AND ra."date" < '2009-07-01'
```
